title: Universal topological statistics on triangulated singular spaces
summary: We prove a universality theorem for random persistent homology over a class of triangulable spaces. More precisely, let $M \subset \mathbb{R}^D$ be a compact $C^2$-triangulable space satisfying a geometric quality condition and let $f: M \to \mathbb{R}$ be a probability density. Then the expected persistence ratio measure computed from the Čech or Vietoris-Rips complex of a Poisson point process with intensity $nf$ has a universal limit independent of $(M, f)$.
